title: Resumption day at the gate
headline: Resumption day at the *gate*
sub: Clearance worked out for every child; one phone at the gate.

bridge.en: At night, the day's money has to add up. Does it?
bridge.pcm: For night, the day money must add up. E dey add?

flow.action: Stands at the green gate holding a phone in both hands at chest height, then lifts one hand to wave a child in
flow.setting: the green iron gate of Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a cream two-storey classroom block with a pine-green stripe, a red-earth yard, a flame tree, a gatehouse with a folding stool

flow.action: Stands in the office doorway with his phone, watches the yard, and gives a slow reassured nod
flow.setting: the bursar's office at Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a wooden desk under a ceiling fan, grey filing cabinets, green fee ledgers stacked, a window onto the yard

en: Clearance is worked out, never set by hand.
Amaka owes, but met the principal.
He types why. It is kept with his name.
Mallam Audu's phone shows only the gate.
A child arrives. He types a few letters.
See the bursar. She goes to the office.
pcm: Dem dey work out clearance, nobody dey set am by hand.
Amaka dey owe, but dem don meet the principal.
E type why. Dem keep am with im name.
Cleared, and dem keep the reason.
She don dey under Cleared now.
Mallam Audu phone dey show only the gate.
Child reach. E type few letters.
See the bursar. She go go the office.
